packageRules.description: Microsoft.Agents.AI and Microsoft.Agents.AI.Abstractions 1.24.0 is the supported floor of Mnemosyne.NET.AgentFramework: a host on an older line must still be able to use the package, so the floor is raised by hand, not by a bot.
Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage must move together with xunit.v3: CodeCoverage 18.1.0 and later need version 2 of Microsoft.Testing.Platform, while xunit.v3 3.x runs on version 1.
